<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a quest item, obtained from the [[astrologer]] when he gives you a [[quest]] to retrieve the [[keepers journal]]. Upon using it at the study table with the [[instructions for key]] from [[Snake]], the [[active key]] will be created, which can then be given to [[Snake]] to unlock the [[dungeon]]. Beyond this, there is no known purpose for this item.
